name: page-preview-state
goal: Each declared page preview selects its own recorded state in both renderers

evidence: Agent settings has an explicit preview state but its scenario names no units per state. Reports would select the first compact-controls screenshot instead of the Settings page.
test/utils/preview-binding.test.ts used only ideal synthetic states. Extend it across every committed active page preview to require its own state membership, so both catalog renderers agree.
